items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: My brother had a trumpet player named Dick Vance, and there was certain systems there, the Schillinger system, Eddie Barefield, (unintelligible) the great lead saxophonist, you know, he played with Fletcher, too. They all went to school and studied this system so I got in on this.

ctx.x: Where did you go, or -- how did you study, what did you study?

You know, I studied a little bit arranging, but they had the different systems in New York, you know -- excuse me -- it got to be a fad around there with the guys. My brother had a trumpet player named Dick Vance, and there was certain systems there, the Schillinger system, Eddie Barefield, (unintelligible) the great lead saxophonist, you know, he played with Fletcher, too. They all went to school and studied this system so I got in on this. I first had enrolled at Walter Damrosch (unintelligible), studying…
Did you work with him personally?
